description: This file contains the implementation of the ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommand class, which is an immutable class that represents a specific command to modify a feature property in a live signals context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for creating instances, accessing command details, and setting headers.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: Immutable class implementing ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommand, representing a command to modify a feature property in a live context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl from a generic Command object, casting it appropriately.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature to modify.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer specifying the property to modify.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the new value for the property.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with specified Ditto headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization (returns false).

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Creates a builder for formulating responses to this command.
